description_en: Queries the elastic network interfaces (ENIs) within a virtual private cloud (VPC) that can serve as multicast sources or multicast members for multicast communication
description_zh: 调用ListGrantVSwitchEnis接口查询在一个专有网络内部，哪些弹性网卡的配置可以成为组播源或者组播成员用来进行组播通信
kebab_example: aliyun cbn list-grant-vswitch-enis --cen-id cen-a7syd349kne38g0000 --vpc-id vpc-p0w9alkte4w2htrqe0000 --vswitch-id vsw-p0w9s2ig1jnwgrbzl0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListGrantVSwitchEnis

parameters.help_en: The ID of the CEN instance to which the VPC-connected instance is connected
parameters.help_zh: VPC实例连接的云企业网实例的ID
parameters.name: cen_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC-connected instance
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of a vSwitch in the VPC-connected instance.

You can query network interface controller (NIC) information for only one vSwitch at a time
parameters.help_zh:
VPC实例下的一个交换机ID。

一次仅支持查询一个交换机下的弹性网卡的信息
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

If this is the first query or no next query exists, leave this parameter empty.
If a next query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次 API 调用返回的 NextToken 值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Valid values: 10 to 500.

Default value:
If you do not set this parameter, the default value is 20.
If the value you set is greater than 500, the default value is 500
parameters.help_zh:
分页查询时每页的最大条目数。取值范围：10~500。

默认值：
当不设置值时，默认值为20。
当设置的值大于500时，默认值为500
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The IDs of network interface controllers (NICs)
parameters.name: network_interface_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs). You can use this parameter to filter network interface controllers (NICs) by name
parameters.name: network_interface_name

parameters.help_en: The primary private IP IPv4 address of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs). You can use this parameter to filter network interface controllers (NICs) by primary private IP address
parameters.name: primary_ip_address

GrantVSwitchEnis.description_en: The list of network interface controller (NIC) information

items.description_en: The elastic network interfaces (ENIs) information. Each entry contains the details of a network interface controller (NIC)

Description.description_en: The description of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs). This describes the network interface controller (NIC)

NetworkInterfaceId.description_en: The ID of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs). This is the network interface controller (NIC) identifier

NetworkInterfaceName.description_en: The name of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs). This is the network interface controller (NIC) name

PrimaryIpAddress.description_en: The primary private IP IPv4 address of the elastic network interfaces (ENIs). This is the network interface controller (NIC) primary private IP address

TransitRouterFlag.description_en:
Indicates whether the elastic network interface (ENI) is created by a transit router for routing and forwarding purposes.

true: The ENI is created by a transit router.
false: The ENI is not created by a transit router.

Elastic network interfaces (ENIs) created by transit routers cannot serve as multicast sources or multicast members
TransitRouterFlag.description_zh:
当前弹性网卡是否是转发路由器创建的。

true：是。
false：否。

转发路由器创建的弹性网卡不支持成为组播源或者组播成员

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned for this query
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次读取的最大数据量

NextToken.description_en: The token returned for this query
NextToken.description_zh: 本次调用返回的查询凭证值

TotalCount.description_en:
The total number of entries returned.
<notice>When you use the MaxResults and NextToken parameters for paging, the returned Total parameter value is meaningless.></notice>
TotalCount.description_zh:
列表条目数。
<notice>使用MaxResults和NextToken参数进行分页查询时，返回的Total参数值无意义。></notice>
